name: Zypher
author: PixelPhobicGames; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: Zypher by PixelPhobicGames, a side-scrolling shooter for the Game Boy made for the Game Boy Competition 2021: fly over the hills and shoot down everything that comes your way. GPL-3.0 (github.com/PixelPhobicGames/Zypher).
